protocol.name: guarded-provider-v2
protocol.selection: 3 known development failures + 2 known successes; not a full-suite or blind result
protocol.change: Provider/model settings only; frozen guarded workflow; no runtime or independent-scenario prompt changes
protocol.unchanged: Identical first prompt; same feedback construction on each model own candidate, max 2 calls, 15000 tokens, 2048 output tokens, 600s, dual validation and rollback
protocol.limits: Different tokenizers, service/cache and cloud weight identity; not an algorithm improvement or proof of intrinsic model capability
protocol.order: Alternating arm order; fresh independent model requests

metrics.budget_enforcement: estimated preflight + returned usage; not a provider billing hard cap
